svg.aria-label: Twenty-two rows, one for each Major Arcana card from the Fool to the World. Each row carries one dot for every calendar date whose birth month plus birth day lands on that card. The rows are widest in the middle of the deck, where the Hanged One holds 21 days, and narrowest at the two ends, where the Fool and the Magician hold 12 days each. All 366 days of the year are accounted for.
svg.text: 366 birthdays across twenty-two Bearings, one dot a day.
A month and a day rarely add to very little, or to very much.
Widest: The Hanged One, 21 days. Narrowest: The Fool and The Magician, 12 each.
Every date in the year is on this chart exactly once.
